name: uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase

function.text: UROD encodes uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase. Annotated molecular activities include uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity. It participates in heme biosynthetic process and heme B biosynthetic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to UROD-related phototoxic porphyria (semidominant); familial porphyria cutanea tarda (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Semidominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
